lens: Geometry and proportion first, then materials and colour, then artefacts. Fabrics judged as photo-vs-render crops at a matched physical scale, with the 17 in (0.43 m) seat width as the ruler. Head 2c1eb9d: the econ source is unchanged since ced028f (rated wF), and lighting round 1 (2913db8) is now in. Measurements (box mean, L p90/p50 and p10/p50, B/R) come from /tmp/claude-0/rater14B/m.py. Crops are in /tmp/claude-0/rater14B/tops.png (back tops and covers), diam.png (e1 diamond vs y_47306 L) and studio.png (e1-e9 contact sheet). Lighting and QA camera placement are noted but not scored.

priorIssues.issue: wFb-1 headrest cover saturated navy instead of slate leatherette; bright head-on
priorIssues.evidence: Head-on q15 cover/back L50 ratios are 0.86 / 0.88 / 1.02 / 1.02, against 0.71 / 0.90 / 0.54 / 0.75 in y_47300. The render covers are B/R 1.88-1.98 at L50 55-65; seats 3 and 4 in the photo are #1e243c / #1c2238 at L50 35-37. Oblique (q16 near) the cover is #313a65 at B/R 2.04, against #3b3f5f at B/R 1.61 in y_47301. The cover is still flat, with no fold lip, seam or logo (tops.png vs y_47306).

priorIssues.issue: wFb-2 / w13b-3 dash mosaic reads as heather; the block structure is missing
priorIssues.evidence: The tile is unchanged (the w11 tile, ced028f). q15 s2 and the e7 pans show an even scatter of dashes, where y_47306 R shows brick blocks of different dash density.

priorIssues.issue: w13b-1 diamond figure/ground (rings on a strict lattice)
priorIssues.evidence: diam.png: e1 s1 shows a perfectly regular quincunx of ring-like figures, each a light outline round a dark centre. The y_47306 L figures are solid stepped stars that vary in size, on a brighter royal-blue ground, and the lattice is less rigid.

priorIssues.issue: w13b-2 tick columns weak at row distance
priorIssues.evidence: q15 s1 / s3 backs: p10/p50 0.66 / 0.68, against 0.45 / 0.43 in y_47300 s1 / s3. p90/p50 is 1.65 / 1.63 against 1.53 / 1.53. So the light ticks are fine, but the dark channels between the columns are lifted and the columns read soft.

priorIssues.issue: w13b-4 / wFb-5 white hood rim across the back tops head-on
priorIssues.evidence: tops.png: in the q15 near row a white rim about 3-4 px (~1 cm) runs across every back top, and the inner edges of seats 1 and 3 show white shell bands of about 15 px (~7 % of the back width). In y_47300 the fabric runs to the top edge, and white shows only on the aisle-end seats. In q16 the near-seat hood side shows as a white band of ~25 px, against ~8-10 px on the matching seat in y_47301.

details.refs: diam.png vs y_47306 L: the scale is right; the figures are rigid rings, not solid irregular stars; the ground is too dark

q15 s4 p90/p50 1.83 vs 1.90 (y_47300 s4), B/R 2.18 vs 2.31, good at row distance. Close up (q16 foreground, tops.png) the flecks are round white blobs ~1.5-2 cm where the y_47306 / y_47301 flecks are small, elongated pale-blue slivers
y_47306 R, y_47300 s4 pan: the render is an even scatter with no density blocks
q15 / q16 / e1: the variety and per-seat L50 (54-73 vs 46-91) are within the photo range
The pad wings and widths are good. The cover is navy where the photo's is slate leatherette, bright head-on (cover/back 1.02 vs 0.54-0.75 on s3/s4), with no fold lip, seam or logo
q15 #263155 vs y_47300 #2d3659; plain face; the render's is a little flatter (p10/p50 0.82 vs 0.55: no pillow shading creases)
e7 / q17 vs y_47303: the shape is good, a shade whiter than the photo's light grey
e1 / e7 vs y_47303; y_47300 s1 pan #4a5880 B/R 1.74, and the render pans are in that family
q15 / e4 vs y_47306: the back rises ~0.2 back-widths above the cover top (render 0.21, y_47306 0.17); y_47300 is flush (possibly raised headrests, see question)

From behind (q17 / q18 / e9) it is good, but the shell is a little dark and grey in q18 (#a5a9b1 vs #b8bfcd in y_47305; lighting-dominated). From the front, the white rim and the inner white side bands show (tops.png)

q18 vs y_47305: the screen fills ~0.83 of the hood width against ~0.75 in the photo, and sits proud with a heavy dark bezel, where the photo's sits in a light-grey recessed bay with a sloped margin. The handset dock is squarer than the photo's rounded pill
e8 / e2 vs y_47303: the legs are a little thin and pale
q15 / q16 far rows vs y_47300 / y_47301: consistent, with no LOD pop

issues.title: Headrest cover: navy, bright head-on, plain plate (carried from wFb-1)
issues.evidence: q15 cover/back 0.86 / 0.88 / 1.02 / 1.02 vs y_47300 0.71 / 0.90 / 0.54 / 0.75. Oblique q16 #313a65 (B/R 2.04) vs y_47301 #3b3f5f (B/R 1.61) and y_47306 slate grey. There is no fold-over lip, seam or wing logo (y_47306).
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover -> about #3c4260 (B/R ~1.5), roughness 0.65-0.7, so the head-on specular drops and cover/back reaches ~0.7. In 09a_econ.js add a 6-8 mm rounded fold lip along the cover top, a 1 mm darker inset seam 1 cm in, and a ~12 mm light-grey logo quad at the lower right.

issues.title: White shell visible from the front: top rim and inner side bands
issues.evidence: tops.png: a ~1 cm white rim runs across the q15 near-row back tops, and the inner side bands are ~7 % of the back width. On the q16 near seat the side band is ~25 px against ~8-10 px in y_47301. In y_47300 the fabric runs to the edge.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js RS / hood: pull the cap rows 8-10 mm aft, behind the fabric crown, and narrow the hood side wrap by ~1 cm per side (or widen the fabric back's rolled edge by the same), so only a thin sliver shows head-on.

issues.title: Dash mosaic lacks the density blocks (carried)
issues.evidence: y_47306 R shows brick blocks in three dash densities, with the dashes running across the block edges. The render is a uniform scatter (q15 s2, e7).
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_mosaic: per-block density from {0.12, 0.30, 0.55}, with blocks of irregular width, dashes crossing the block edges, no empty margins, and the dashes near-white on a deep navy ground (light/dark ~2.5).

issues.title: Diamond: rigid ring lattice instead of solid irregular stars
issues.evidence: diam.png: the e1 s1 figures are hollow rings on an exact quincunx; the y_47306 L figures are solid stepped stars that vary in size, on a brighter royal-blue ground.
issues.fix: y_diamond: fill the figures solid (half-diagonal 0.026-0.031, light area ~0.2), jitter the size by ±20 %, drop ~20 % of the sites, and lift the ground ~15 % toward #3550a0.

issues.title: Tick columns soft at row distance (dark channels lifted)
issues.evidence: q15 s1/s3 p10/p50 0.66/0.68 vs y_47300 0.45/0.43, with p90/p50 already at or above the photo.
issues.fix: synth_y_tick: remove or halve the dark lift so the channels reach about 0.45 of the median at row distance; keep the highlight level.

issues.title: Fleck snow-blobs up close
issues.evidence: q16 foreground / tops.png: round white blobs ~1.5-2 cm vs small elongated pale-blue slivers in y_47306 / y_47301.
issues.fix: y_fleck: 2.5:1 slivers ~1 cm long, tinted #9fb3e6, keeping the bright fraction (~0.2).

issues.title: Screen proud with a heavy bezel; no recessed bay
issues.evidence: q18 vs y_47305: the screen spans ~0.83 of the hood width vs ~0.75, with no light-grey sloped recess round it.
issues.fix: Shrink the screen + bezel ~8 % in width, set it back 4 mm, and add a 6-8 mm sloped light-grey frame ring (yShell tone, not dark).

issues.title: Seat shells read grey under the cabin light (not scored)
issues.evidence: q18 shell #a5a9b1 L50 175 vs y_47305 #b8bfcd L50 192; the q16 near-back fabric is L50 70 vs 50 in y_47301, closer than wF (the near fabric was lit too light).
issues.fix: Lighting: a little more fill on the seat-back faces facing aft, or a lower AO weight on vertical seat faces.

issues.title: Camera mismatches (not scored)
issues.evidence: The q15 eye is lower and closer than y_47300's, so the pillows fill the frame bottom. q16 looks at the backs of the row ahead where y_47301 looks along the aisle. q17's viewpoint differs from y_47303's.
issues.fix: Match the q15/q16/q17 cameras to the photos.

questionsForUser: Is the headrest-cover leatherette slate grey-blue (as in y_47301 / y_47306) or dark navy (as in the head-on y_47300)? The render follows the navy.

In y_47300 the headrest pads sit flush with the back tops, while in y_47306 the back rises ~8 cm above the pad. Are the y_47300 headrests raised? An in-flight front view at the default headrest height would settle it.
